## What this dashboard shows

- Consolidated view of 69 active profit centers across Wipro Enterprises, drawing data from multiple ERP systems (SAP BDC, SAP S/4HANA systems A & B, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Tally Prime), with some simulated data included.
- Total revenue of ₹2377.93B generating gross margin of ₹1130.37B at an overall margin of 47.5%, well above the 30% healthy threshold.
- Performance spans Consumer Care & Lighting, Infrastructure Engineering, and Joint Ventures segments, with drill-down capability to individual profit centers.

## What to report

- The group delivered ₹2377.93B in profit-center-assigned revenue with a healthy overall margin of 47.5% (₹1130.37B gross margin), comfortably exceeding the 30% benchmark.
- Top performers include WIN1AER Aerospace at 91.3% margin (₹43.10B revenue), US10_PLX at 92.9% margin (₹27.06B revenue), and WIN1WTR Water at 52.6% margin (₹51.33B revenue).
- The five largest profit centers by revenue are ₹265.62B (36.1% margin), EQ Healthcare equipment ₹260.70B (42.5% margin), 10 Personal Care ₹160.94B (48.5% margin), SV Healthcare services ₹137.87B (40.9% margin), and 10 Personal Care ₹103.49B (47.3% margin).
- The PC Health Scorecard shows a mix of above-target, on-target, and below-target performers against an equal-share benchmark, indicating uneven contribution across the 69 profit centers.

## Watch out for

- Two profit centers show severe distress: WIN1ADD Additive Manufacturing reports a negative margin of -29.2% (₹43.50B revenue, ₹56.21B expense) and WIN1HYD Hydraulics shows an anomalous 173.0% margin with negative expense of -₹26.71B, suggesting data quality or classification issues.
- Several profit centers carry codes (US10_PCR1S, US10_PCM1S, US10_PCC1S, US10_PLX) rather than business names, making performance interpretation difficult; clarify naming conventions and business ownership.
- Data includes "Simulated SAP" and "Simulated" source records explicitly noted in the scope selector, indicating that some figures are not actual transactional data—confirm the percentage of simulated vs. real data underlying these results.
- Revenue figures are stated before intercompany eliminations; actual consolidated group revenue will be lower once intra-group transactions are removed for statutory reporting.
